snippet.title: Vibrance motion graphics
snippet.description:
When I work with the big tech companies, Google and Samsung,
There were few explorations and tests that I made and liked, but didn’t out to final ver.
I thought It’d be good to archive them somewhere!

So I make this vibrance visual motion graphics,
recreated some shots used the google style and focused on transition.

If you want to see
what I worked for Google with ordinary folks, link here:)
https://youtu.be/qbqZQFOVfA8?si=9Q6ph4iWN8V-DYIH

Cosmonkey - Bubbles Drop
